Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: Compare AlphaBes Free and Pro plans. Pro is $7.99/month or $59/year.
Pricing.heading: Pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade any time.
Pricing.intro: The free plan covers the alphabet basics: letter lessons, a selection of worksheets, and a few games. Pro is for parents and teachers who want the full library — every printable worksheet across all 26 letters, every game, full phonics and CVC-word practice, printable bundles for a whole classroom, and progress tracking for each child.
